scenicChapters.title: Route of the Seven Lakes
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 50 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

ca-laurentian-curves-loop.legalNote: Check provincial road reports, wildfire closures, ferries and fuel range. Specific flag: seasonal.

scenicChapters.title: Lachute → Mont-Tremblant
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 66 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

legend-bosnia-una-river-route.slogan: Bosnia Una River Route – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-bosnia-una-river-route.story: curated scenic road. waterfalls, river canyons, forest. A one-way ride of 65 km, Bihać to Drvar - roughly 1 h 11 in the saddle. The stops in between: Orašac and Bosnia Una River Route. The highest point is about 1,000 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Bosnia Una River Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 21 km this is Bosnia Una River Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

core-needles-highway-and-iron-mountain-r.title: Needles Highway and Iron Mountain Road
core-needles-highway-and-iron-mountain-r.slogan: One of America's most concentrated scenic riding loops.
core-needles-highway-and-iron-mountain-r.story: One of America's most concentrated scenic riding loops. The road: SD-87 and US-16A. Distance and riding time are estimates from the checkpoints until the road is measured on this page.
